ModMetaData.name: Grenade One-Use Patch 1.5 v1.1
ModMetaData.author: Allen / ChatGPT
ModMetaData.description: Independent RimWorld 1.5 patch for disposable grenade-style throwables. V1.1 consumes one physical item only for explosive/area-effect grenade projectiles. Non-explosive physical thrown weapons such as javelins, throwing axes and throwing knives are intentionally excluded so Recoverable Throwables can manage them.
